ambient: The heating comes on, as it does at this hour, in a place with no heating.
A key turns in a lock somewhere below and you know exactly whose it is and cannot say.
The room gets very slightly smaller, and settles.
description: Your own rooms, laid out from memory by someone working off a description. The furniture is right and standing in the wrong relationships. The window shows the correct view from a floor you do not live on. Everything is clean in a way you have never managed.
name: Your Place, Slightly Wrong

looks: Arranged by someone being careful. Nothing is where you put it.
One object is missing and you cannot work out which, only that the room is lighter without it.
They have been dusted. You feel obscurely accused.
objects.name: your things

looks: The right street, seen from about nine floors too high.
It is the hour just before the light arrives, and it stays that hour.
Your reflection is in it, doing the washing up behind you.
objects.name: the window

looks: You do not have another room.
Ajar, and the light beyond it is on, and the bill for it is yours.
Someone in there stops moving when you look.
objects.name: the door to the other room

weather: Through the window the light of a whole day passes and comes back round, and the room does not change with it.
